lines.text: David will bless God's name forever and ever and says the LORD's greatness is unsearchable.
One generation will commend God's works to the next, and David will meditate on His wondrous works.
All He has made will give the LORD thanks, and His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom.
The LORD lifts up all who are bowed down and gives them rain in season.
The LORD is near to all who keep the Sabbath, and He hears the cry of those who fear Him.
